_description: LGC_VRCMAFury_中文拓展 2.3.7；补充世界 SDK 上传页与常用组件。worldEntries 用于世界组件上下文专用显示；panelEntries / panelTemplates 用于上传显示，panelFragments 仅处理模板明确标记的 SDK 说明片段。

entries.key: Lists the bones that will be scaled away for the local player.
entries.value: 指定在本地玩家视角中通过缩小来隐藏的骨骼。

entries.key: A global scale applied to all bones targeted by this component, ranging from 0 (all bones fully scaled away) to 1 (all bones use their individual scale factors).
entries.value: 对本组件的所有目标骨骼应用全局缩放。范围为 0（所有目标骨骼完全缩小隐藏）至 1（各骨骼使用各自的缩放系数）。

entries.key: The bone transform to apply scaling to.
entries.value: 需要应用缩放的骨骼变换。

entries.key: The scale factor to apply to this specific bone, ranging from 0 (bone fully scaled away) to 1 (bone uses its usual scale).
entries.value: 此骨骼的缩放系数。范围为 0（完全缩小隐藏）至 1（使用正常大小）。

entries.key: A condition controlling whether this bone will be scaled away.
entries.value: 控制此骨骼在什么条件下应用缩小隐藏。
目标渲染器（最多 {4} 个）
解除冻结时重新烘焙偏移

entries.key: Select this avatar in the SDK control panel
entries.value: 在 SDK 控制面板中选择此 Avatar

entries.key: Global collision is not supported on Plane colliders.
entries.value: 平面碰撞体不支持全局碰撞。

entries.key: This PhysBone has no parent. It is strongly recommended that you make the PhysBone a child of another game object to avoid unusual behavior.
entries.value: 此 PhysBone 没有父对象。强烈建议将 PhysBone 设为其他游戏对象的子对象，以避免异常行为。

entries.key: The root transform of this PhysBone has no parent. It is strongly recommended that you make the PhysBone's root transform a child of another game object to avoid unusual behavior.
entries.value: 此 PhysBone 的根变换没有父对象。强烈建议将其设为其他游戏对象的子对象，以避免异常行为。

entries.key: There are too many collision tags attached to this contact. Only the first 16 tags will be used.
entries.value: 此接触组件附加的碰撞标签过多，只会使用前 16 个标签。

entries.key: You must have at least one collision tag, otherwise this contact won't do anything.
entries.value: 至少需要一个碰撞标签，否则此接触组件不会产生作用。
全局碰撞允许其他对象
目标渲染器（最多 4 个）

entries.key: Choose a parameter name to use this feature.
entries.value: 请设置参数名称以使用此功能。

entries.key: Choose a contact parameter or shader parameter override to use this feature.
entries.value: 请设置接触参数或着色器参数覆盖以使用此功能。

entries.key: Warning: This will delete all parameter behaviors on this Avatar. Are you sure you want to continue?
entries.value: 警告：这将删除此 Avatar 的全部参数行为。确定继续？

entries.key: This will erase any face tracking settings. Are you sure?
entries.value: 这将清除全部面部追踪设置。确定继续？

entries.key: Determines how forces are applied.  Certain kinds of motion may require using a specific integration type.
entries.value: 决定力的计算方式。某些运动可能需要使用特定的积分方式。

entries.key: The transform where this component begins.  If left blank, we assume we start at this game object.
entries.value: 组件开始生效的变换。留空时使用此游戏对象的变换。

entries.key: List of ignored transforms that shouldn't be affected by this component.  Ignored transforms automatically include any of that transform's children.
entries.value: 不受此组件影响的变换列表；被忽略变换的所有子对象也会一并忽略。

entries.key: When enabled, automatically ignore transforms targeted by another physbone component. These are determined at initialization and regardless if the components are enabled or disabled.
entries.value: 自动忽略其他 PhysBone 组件控制的变换。此项在初始化时确定，与组件是否启用无关。

entries.key: Vector used to create additional bones at each endpoint of the chain. Only used if the value is non-zero.
entries.value: 在骨骼链的每个末端创建附加骨骼所用的向量，仅在非零时生效。

entries.key: Determines how transforms with multiple children are handled. By default those transforms are ignored.
entries.value: 决定如何处理具有多个子对象的变换，默认忽略这些变换。

entries.key: Amount of force used to return bones to their rest position.
entries.value: 将骨骼拉回静止位置的力。

entries.key: Amount bones will wobble when trying to reach their rest position.
entries.value: 骨骼回到静止位置时的摆动程度。

entries.key: Amount bones will try and stay at their current orientation.
entries.value: 骨骼维持当前朝向的程度。

entries.key: Amount of gravity applied to bones.  Positive value pulls bones down, negative pulls upwards.
entries.value: 施加到骨骼的重力。正值向下，负值向上。

entries.key: Reduces gravity while bones are at their rest orientation.  Gravity will increase as bones rotate away from their rest orientation, reaching full gravity at 90 degress from rest.
entries.value: 骨骼处于静止朝向时减弱重力，偏离静止朝向后重力逐渐增强，偏离 90 度时达到完整重力。

entries.key:
Determines how immobile is calculated.

All Motion - Reduces any motion as calculated from the root transform's parent.World - Reduces positional movement from locomotion, any movement due to animations or IK still affect bones normally.
entries.value: 决定运动抑制的计算方式。全部运动：抑制根变换父级产生的运动；世界空间：抑制移动引起的位置变化，动画和 IK 仍正常影响骨骼。

entries.key: Reduces the effect movement has on bones. The greater the value the less motion affects the chain as determined by the Immobile Type.
entries.value: 减弱移动对骨骼的影响，数值越大，按所选方式抑制的运动越多。

entries.key: Whether to allow collision with colliders other than the ones specified on this component. This includes each player's hands as defined by their avatar as well as any global colliders in the world.
entries.value: 允许与本组件列表之外的碰撞体碰撞，包括其他玩家的手部及世界中的全局碰撞体。

entries.key: Collision radius around each bone.  Used for both collision and grabbing.
entries.value: 每段骨骼周围的碰撞半径，同时用于碰撞与抓取。

entries.key: List of colliders that specifically collide with these bones. These will always collide regardless of what Allow Collision is set to.
entries.value: 始终与这些骨骼碰撞的碰撞体列表，不受“允许碰撞”设置影响。

entries.key: Type of angular limit applied to each bone.
entries.value: 应用到每段骨骼的角度限制方式。

entries.key: Maximum angle each bone can rotate from its rest position.
entries.value: 骨骼相对静止朝向可以旋转的最大角度。

entries.key: Rotates the angular limits on each axis.
entries.value: 旋转各轴的角度限制范围。

entries.key: Allows players to grab the bones.
Allows players to pose the bones after grabbing.
entries.value: 允许玩家抓取后固定骨骼姿态。

entries.key: When a bone is grabbed it will snap to the hand grabbing it.
entries.value: 抓取骨骼时将其吸附到抓取的手上。

entries.key:
Controls how grabbed bones move.
A value of zero results in bones using pull & spring to reach the grabbed position.
A value of one results in bones immediately moving to the grabbed position.
entries.value: 抓取时骨骼的移动方式：0 使用回拉力与弹性到达目标位置；1 立即移到目标位置。

entries.key: Maximum amount the bones can stretch.  This value is a multiple of the original bone length.
entries.value: 骨骼最多可以拉伸的程度，以原始骨长的倍数计算。

entries.key: Maximum amount the bones can shrink.  This value is a multiple of the original bone length.
entries.value: 骨骼最多可以压缩的程度，以原始骨长的倍数计算。

entries.key: The amount motion will affect the stretch/squish of the bones.  A value of zero means bones will only stretch/squish as a result of grabbing or collisions.
entries.value: 运动对骨骼拉伸和挤压的影响程度。0 表示仅在抓取或碰撞时拉伸和挤压。

entries.key: Allows bone transforms to be animated.  Each frame bone rest position will be updated according to what was animated.
entries.value: 允许动画驱动骨骼变换，每帧按动画结果更新骨骼静止位置。

entries.key: When this component becomes disabled, the bones will automatially reset to their default rest position.
entries.value: 停用组件时自动将骨骼恢复到默认静止位置。

entries.key: Keyname used to provide multiple parameters to the avatar controller.
entries.value: 用于向 Avatar 动画控制器提供多个参数的名称前缀。

entries.key: The transform this constraint will be applied to. Leave this blank to apply the constraint to the transform this component is attached to. This reference can only be changed in edit-mode.
entries.value: 应用此约束的变换。留空时使用组件所在对象的变换，此引用只能在编辑模式修改。

entries.key:
If greater than zero, the constraint will smoothly move to its target instead of snapping instantly. Values between zero and one are recommended.

The higher the value, the longer it takes to move to the target.
entries.value: 大于零时，约束将平滑移动到目标而非立即跳转。建议使用 0 到 1 之间的值；值越大，到达目标所需时间越长。

entries.key: When set, solve this constraint in local space. Leave this unset to solve in world space.
entries.value: 启用后在本地空间求解约束，否则在世界空间求解。

entries.key: When set, this constraint will ignore its sources and become locked to the world. Unset it to solve the constraint normally again.
entries.value: 启用后，约束会忽略源对象并固定在世界空间；关闭后恢复正常求解。

entries.key: When set, offsets will be recalculated as the constraint is unfrozen. Unset this to maintain the original offsets.
entries.value: 解除冻结时重新计算偏移。关闭后保留原有偏移。

entries.key: When set, evaluate with the current offsets. When not set, update the offsets based on the current transform. This has no effect in play-mode.
entries.value: 启用时使用当前偏移求解；关闭时根据当前变换更新偏移。此项在运行模式中无效。

entries.key: Transform where this contact is placed.  If empty, we use this game object's transform.
entries.value: 放置接触组件的变换。留空时使用此游戏对象的变换。

entries.key: Type of collision shape used by this contact.
entries.value: 此接触组件使用的碰撞形状。

entries.key: Size of the collider extending from its origin.
entries.value: 碰撞体从原点向外延伸的半径。

entries.key: Height of the capsule along the Y axis, including the half-spheres at each end.
entries.value: 胶囊体沿 Y 轴的总高度，包含两端的半球。

entries.key: Size of the box collider along each axis.
entries.value: 盒体碰撞体在各轴上的尺寸。

entries.key: Position offset from the root transform.
entries.value: 相对根变换的位置偏移。

entries.key: Rotation offset from the root transform.
entries.value: 相对根变换的旋转偏移。

entries.key: Limit this contact to only work on the local client.
entries.value: 使此接触组件仅在本地客户端生效。

entries.key: Limit this contact to only detect other contact components from the chosen sources of content.
entries.value: 仅检测来自所选内容来源的接触组件。

entries.key: Allow this contact to be affected by yourself.
entries.value: 允许自身触发此接触组件。

entries.key: Allow this contact to be affected by other people.
entries.value: 允许其他玩家触发此接触组件。

entries.key: How the receiver reacts to incoming collisions and sets the parameter value.
entries.value: 接收器如何响应接触并设置参数值。

entries.key: The parameter updated on the animation controller.  This parameter DOES NOT need to be defined on the avatar descriptor.
entries.value: 要更新的动画控制器参数，无需在 Avatar 描述器的表情参数中定义。

entries.key: Minimum velocity needed from an incoming collider to affect this trigger.
entries.value: 触发接收器所需的最小接触速度。

entries.key:
Generate additional advanced parameters for this contact receiver.

Keeping advanced parameters you don't need disabled will improve your avatar's performance!
entries.value:
为此接触接收器生成额外的高级参数。

关闭不需要的高级参数可改善 Avatar 性能。

entries.key:
Changing VRCPhysBone versions may change the way your component works.  Some values may act differently and will need to be manually changed.

Please read our online documentation for information on version differences.
entries.value:
更改 VRCPhysBone 版本可能改变组件行为，部分数值的作用可能不同，需要手动调整。

请查阅在线文档了解版本差异。

entries.key: Only enable IsAnimated if you are animating the bone transforms affected by this component. Leaving this disabled is better for performance.
entries.value: 仅在需要用动画驱动此组件影响的骨骼变换时启用“允许动画驱动”；关闭可改善性能。

entries.key: The parameter will be set to 1 while a contact sender is inside the receiver.  Otherwise the value defaults to 0.
entries.value: 接触发送器位于接收器内部时，参数设为 1，否则为 0。

entries.key: Upon first contact if the two contacts' combined velocities are greater then the minVelocity then the parameter will be set to 1 for a single frame.  Otherwise the value defaults to 0.
entries.value: 首次接触时，若两者的合成速度大于最小速度，则将参数设为 1 并保持一帧，否则为 0。

entries.key: It's not necessary to use a synced parameter as defined by the VRCExpressionParameters object.  This parameter is already updated on both the local and remote machine.  If you choose to use a synced parameter we recommend using the Local Only option.
entries.value: 此参数会在本地与远端分别更新，无需在 VRCExpressionParameters 中设为同步参数。若使用同步参数，建议启用“仅本地”。

entries.key: "Execute VRChat Constraints in Edit Mode" is disabled in the SDK Control Panel. Constraints will only run during Play mode.
entries.value: SDK 控制面板未启用“在编辑模式执行 VRChat 约束”，约束只会在运行模式中生效。
默认 T 字姿势（Default TPose）
默认 IK 姿势（Default IKPose）

entries.key: Use Auto-Footsteps for 3 and 4 point tracking
entries.value: 在三点和四点追踪时使用自动脚步

entries.key: Force Locomotion animations for 6 point tracking
entries.value: 在六点追踪时强制使用移动动画

entries.key: With eye tracking, gaze follows your eyes. Without tracking, gaze is simulated.
entries.value: 启用眼球追踪时，视线跟随你的眼睛；没有追踪时，使用模拟视线。

entries.key: Eye gaze is output to eye bones only. Face tracking eye blendshapes are not driven.
entries.value: 仅通过眼球骨骼表现注视方向，不驱动面部追踪的眼部形态键。

entries.key: Eyelids are set to Face Tracking, but Eye Gaze Mode is Bone Rotation. Consider setting Eye Gaze Mode to 'Both' so eye direction affects both eyeball bones and eyelid blendshapes simultaneously.
entries.value: 眼睑已设为面部追踪，但注视模式为骨骼旋转。建议将注视模式设为“两者”，使注视方向同时影响眼球骨骼和眼睑形态键。

entries.key: Eye gaze is output to face tracking blendshapes only. Eye bones stay neutral.
entries.value: 仅通过面部追踪形态键表现注视方向，眼球骨骼保持中立姿势。

entries.key: Eye gaze is output to both eye bones and face tracking blendshapes simultaneously.
entries.value: 同时通过眼球骨骼和面部追踪形态键表现注视方向。

entries.key: If the avatar is only using this face tracking section for advanced viseme support or advanced automatic eyelook support, leave this unchecked. Checking this signals that this avatar supports actual hardware face tracking (via webcam, OSC, etc), and unlocks all the associated tracking keys.
entries.value: 如果人物仅使用此区域来支持高级口型或高级自动注视，请勿勾选。勾选表示人物支持通过摄像头、OSC 等方式输入的真实硬件面部追踪，并解锁全部相关追踪键。

entries.key: Eye look, blink, Voice, and Viseme_* inputs work without 'Use All Tracking Keys'. Visemes require LipSync Mode 'Viseme BlendShape Face Tracking'. Enable 'Use All Tracking Keys' to use hardware face tracking inputs.
entries.value: 即使未启用“使用全部追踪键”，注视、眨眼、Voice 和 Viseme_* 输入也可使用。口型输入需要将口型同步模式设为“口型形态键面部追踪”。若要使用硬件面部追踪输入，请启用“使用全部追踪键”。

entries.key: Define behaviors that combine tracking inputs and apply them to animator parameters, blendshape sets, or individual blendshapes. Forwarding to animator parameters does not require a face tracking mesh.
entries.value: 定义将追踪输入组合后应用于动画控制器参数、形态键集合或单个形态键的行为。仅转发至动画控制器参数时，无须设置面部追踪网格。

entries.key: Viseme Dampen uses hardware face tracking data. Enable 'Use All Tracking Keys' (at the top of the Face Tracking section) to configure it.
entries.value: 口型抑制使用硬件面部追踪数据。请先启用面部追踪区域顶部的“使用全部追踪键”以进行配置。

entries.key: Viseme Dampen requires LipSync Mode 'Viseme BlendShape Face Tracking'. Saved dampening settings have no effect in other lip-sync modes.
entries.value: 口型抑制需要将口型同步模式设为“口型形态键面部追踪”。保存的抑制设置在其他口型同步模式下不生效。

entries.key: Applies to every configured face tracking mesh containing this exact name, including blendshapes added later by build-time tools.
entries.value: 应用于所有已配置且含有这一确切形态键名称的面部追踪网格，包括构建工具后续添加的形态键。

entries.key: Maximum of 32 inputs per behavior reached.
entries.value: 每个行为最多支持 32 个输入，已达到上限。

entries.key: Eyelids will be controlled with the Face Tracking blendshapes.
entries.value: 眼睑将由面部追踪形态键控制。

entries.key: Looking Up/Down eyelid states are disabled because Eye Gaze Mode uses Face Tracking.
entries.value: 注视模式使用面部追踪，因此眼睑的向上／向下看状态已停用。

entries.key: Signals that this avatar supports actual hardware face tracking (via webcam, OSC, etc) and unlocks all the associated tracking keys in blendshape sets and parameter behaviors. Leave unchecked if only using advanced viseme support or advanced automatic eyelook support - eye look, blink, and viseme mapping work without it.
entries.value: 表示此人物支持通过摄像头、OSC 等输入的真实硬件面部追踪，并解锁形态键集合和参数行为中的全部相关追踪键。仅使用高级口型或高级自动注视时请勿勾选；注视、眨眼和口型映射无须此选项也可使用。

entries.key: None: No dampening. Dampen Tracking: Active visemes dampen mouth-related tracking. Dampen Visemes: Tracking dampens visemes.
entries.value: 无：不抑制。抑制追踪：生效的口型抑制嘴部追踪。抑制口型：追踪输入抑制口型。
